name: Flight Pacing
note: Every campaign flight is simulated day by day, so budget bullets, pace, ROAS and lands-at, the cumulative-vs-plan chart with its run-rate confidence cone, and a daily-spend slider that re-projects landing spend and marginal ROAS on a diminishing-returns curve all agree; the table re-sorts with FLIP through the Web Animations API. Height is --dbm-pacing-h (680px), which can be set to 100dvh in an app.

name: Attribution Lab
note: Journeys are generated touch by touch and credited under six models, the data-driven one a ridge logistic regression fitted by IRLS and split by each touch's counterfactual lift, with largest-remainder rounding so parts always sum to totals; slope-chart lines morph through CSS d: path() transitions and path rows reveal on a view() scroll timeline. Height is --dbm-attrib-h, which can be set to 100dvh in an app.

name: Rank Tracker

name: Segment Builder
note: Rules evaluate live against 12,000 generated customers: the estimate counts up, a conic ring turns through a registered @property, each rule shows its own hit count, an index panel compares composition with the base, and a DPR-aware canvas population map lights every match; the add-rule menu is an in-component listbox with arrows, Enter and Escape. Height is --dbm-segment-h, which can be set to 100dvh in an app.

name: Launch War Room
note: A seeded minute-by-minute model of launch day (sessions by source, Poisson orders, a checkout incident, a sell-out) drives a DPR-aware canvas burn-up against a p10 to p90 plan band with a last-hour-pace projection to the stock ceiling, a go/no-go board with hysteresis, a live feed, a sortable channel table and a runbook; the rAF loop pauses off screen and in hidden tabs, and the stock gauge animates a gradient stop through @property. Height is --dbm-warroom-h, which can be set to 100dvh in an app.
